toolbar_toggle_mute: Press M to toggle mute or restore volume
toast_muted_description: Press M again to restore volume.
mode_description: Choose a mode, then configure characters, room, difficulty, and controls.
mode_solo_description: Face zombie hordes and the Red Devil alone for the best combo and survival record.
mode_coop_description: Fight side by side, revive one another, and hold the line with walls and barrels.
mode_ai_description: An AI ally provides automatic cover fire and revives.
mode_deathmatch_description: All weapons unlocked. Win by reaching the target kills first.
reward_survival: REWARDS: Earn up to 10 weapons and 90+ upgrades through multiple zombie kills!
reward_deathmatch: REWARDS: All 10 weapons unlocked! First to {frags} frags wins!
room_start_title: Click map to start the game
startup_stage_initial: Preloading character and weapon rigs, 18 room maps, SVG effects, and sounds…
startup_stage_complete: All character models, 18 maps, SVG effects, and sounds are ready. Opening the main menu!
startup_stage_sounds: Pre-decoding 26 WAV weapon and explosion sound buffers…
startup_stage_effects: Pre-rendering muzzle flashes, explosion smoke, and blood SVG effects…
startup_stage_maps: Loading obstacles and zombie spawn nodes for all 18 room maps (.json)…
startup_stage_models: Loading all character, zombie, and weapon skeletal models (.bbmodel)…
startup_cache_hint: All character models, 18 room maps, SVG combat effects, and WAV sounds are preloaded and cached before the main menu, making later mode changes and room transitions instant.
difficulty_hint: Adjust the number and strength of zombies
collision_hint: Toggle physical collision with zombies, fake walls, and barrels
friendly_fire_hint: Toggle direct firearm damage to co-op teammates. Explosion damage is controlled by the setting below.
blast_damage_deathmatch: Explosion damage is required in deathmatch (10% or On only)
blast_damage_deathmatch_hint: Deathmatch disables the Off option; choose reduced 10% damage or full explosion damage.
blast_damage_hint: Set shockwave damage from explosive weapons and barrels: Off, reduced 10%, or full damage.
ai_partner_description: Configure the AI partner’s zombie and supply detection range and shooting accuracy. Available weapons: Pistol, UZI, and Shotgun.
ai_level_1_description: 155px detection · Basic accuracy (notices nearby targets with a wider aiming error)
ai_level_2_description: 235px detection · Standard accuracy (notices targets at medium range with some aiming error)
ai_level_3_description: 315px detection · High accuracy (finds distant targets and supplies with stable aim)
ai_level_4_description: 420px detection · Perfect lock (immediately detects targets and aims at their center)
sound_description: Control all in-game sound effects, including weapons, reloads, explosions, and zombies.
sound_hint: Controls game sound effects only. Slider and preset changes apply immediately and save automatically. Press M anytime to mute or restore volume.
controls_description: Select a binding, then press a keyboard key to assign it. Press ESC to cancel.
highscores_description: Automatically records your best combo, longest survival time, and room records.
starting_wave_description: Set the starting wave for survival and AI co-op modes.
starting_wave_select: Choose the starting wave for survival mode
options_deathmatch_goal_hint: Set the deathmatch victory goal. The first player to score 5, 10, 20, or 50 frags wins.
options_game_speed_hint: Set game speed: Slow runs at 0.5×, Normal at 1×, and Fast at 2×.
